title: Daily briefing: Chemistry Nobel goes to mirror-molecule researchers
title_zh: 每日简报：化学诺贝尔奖授予镜像分子研究者
abstract: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai have won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Plus, the biggest success stories in cancer survival and one of the biggest debates in neuroscience.
abstract_zh: Henri Kagan 和 Kenso Soai 获得化学诺贝尔奖。此外，癌症生存率的最大成功案例以及神经科学界最大的争论之一。
